1479-2638-5700-5701-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2638-5700-5701-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

751-2226-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
751-2226-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Shrieking Drake enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2447-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf, adding {C}{C}.
When Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf enters, it triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-2447-5003.notes: If you execute this combo while it's night, you'll make two tokens each loop and gain infinite creature tokens. You can still execute the combo while it's day without getting the infinite tokens.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7728.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Voracious Brood.
When Voracious Brood dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

4377-7068-7722.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Baboon Spirit.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

3921-7009-7638.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
3921-7009-7638.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Winding Constrictor.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3644-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Young Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
3644-3967-6972.notes: If Young Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

3490-3641-4659-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-3641-4659-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-1849-2557-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7157.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

791-2290-7061.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
791-2290-7061.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

804-3557-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
804-3557-7009.description:
Activate Sakashima the Impostor using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Brago. Brago triggers, blinking Sakashima the Impostor. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

1497-2173-5220-6559.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1545-2034-3000-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Trostani triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
1545-2034-3000-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

4885-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-5233-6517.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5233-6517.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Dragonback Assault, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1445-4871-5147-5631.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5147-5631.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2018-3216-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Suncleanser, adding one mana of any color.
When Suncleanser dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Suncleanser from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Suncleanser enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Suncleanser.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

804-2713-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima the Impostor has a power of at least 2.
804-2713-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Sakashima the Impostor and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Sakashima the Impostor to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

236-643-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
Maskwood Nexus does not have summoning sickness.
236-643-1636.description:
Cast Bring to Life by paying {2}{U}, causing Maskwood Nexus to become a 0/0 artifact creature, then putting four +1/+1 counters on it and exiling Bring to Life.
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token.
When the Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

687-2220-4050-4871.description:
Cast Deadly Grub by paying {2}{B}.
Deadly Grub enters the battlefield with three time counters and a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing the three time counters from Deadly Grub.
Deadly Grub's vanishing ability triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Deadly Grub, adding {1}.
Deadly Grub dies, triggering itself and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Deadly Grub trigger, creating a 6/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
The Insect dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Deadly Grub trigger from step 4, doing nothing since Deadly Grub is no longer on the battlefield.
Resolve the Tayam ability from step 3, causing you to mill three cards and return Deadly Grub from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

760-3575-4053.description:
Activate Aerie Ouphes by sacrificing itself.
Aerie Ouphes' persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Aerie Ouphes ability, dealing damage equal to its power to Swans of Bryn Argoll, causing you to draw cards equal to the damage prevented this way.
Repeat.

938-1582-3771-4050.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
938-1582-3771-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Marang River Prowler, adding {U}.
Cast Marang River Prowler from your graveyard for {U}.
Ominous Roost triggers, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
Repeat.

45-1987-3075-3227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
45-1987-3075-3227.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
